title: Ansible@13: pyasn1 has quadratic-complexity denial of service in binary REAL decoding (CVE-2026-119197)
description: pyasn1 versions up to 0.6.4 have a denial-of-service vulnerability in decoding binary-encoded ASN.1 REAL values with large mantissas. The decoding process is quadratic in the mantissa length, causing excessive CPU consumption. This affects BER, CER, and DER decoders using the shared RealPayloadDecoder. An attacker supplying crafted ASN.1 REAL values to an application using these decoders can cause CPU exhaustion during decoding. The issue is fixed in pyasn1 version 0.6.5.
